maxAmountUsdc.description: Hard spend cap. The skill refuses any single 402 payment above this many USDC. Default: 1.0.

allowMainnet.description: Authorize real-money payments on solana-mainnet. Default: true. Set false to restrict to devnet.

maxTotalUsdc.description: Optional cumulative spend cap across this process's lifetime. Bounds a malicious endpoint that tries to drain the wallet one under-cap payment at a time.

allowedRecipients.description: Optional allowlist of recipient (payTo) addresses. If set, the skill refuses to pay any 402 whose recipient is not listed.

rpcUrl.description: Optional Solana RPC URL override (use a private RPC in production). Defaults to the public endpoint for the selected network.
